subject: Kickoff: Betum Tool for the Artemis Workshop (Dakar, June 1-5)
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off Betum Tool - our benchmarking toolkit for the Artemis Workshop in Dakar, June 1-5. The name comes from the Wolof phrase for "The Eye of the Field", which I love.

The design is deliberately simple: four student teams tackle the same agricultural detection task with four different architectures - OWL-ViT for open-vocabulary zero-shot, YOLO26 for real-time supervised, SAM 3 promptable segmentation converted to boxes, and a generative-perception track - and everyone is compared on exactly one metric, AP@50 via COCOEval. One number, no leaderboard lawyering.

Dataset is the Coffee & Cashew set (Sanya et al., 2024). Milestones: toolkit alpha with all four model profiles running by 4/3, dataset hosting + eval harness frozen by 5/1, docs and dry-run complete by window close 5/25 so we ship a stable artifact to Dakar.

Bao - staffing and hosting plan please.

Dmitri
